blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks—spanning dense and sparse predictions—remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures.
In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection.
Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure – a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively.
Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency.
Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.
blocks.zh:
泛泛而论的多任务愿景模式旨在将多个愿景任务统一在一个框架内,使学习更加有效和多功能。 然而,处理各种不同的远景任务——扩大密集和稀少的预测——由于其固有的产出结构不同而仍然具有挑战性。
在本文中,我们提出AHMAD,这是一个简单而有效的通用多任务学习框架,它融合了不同的关键视觉任务:语义分化,实例分化,深度估计,关键点检测,以及物体检测.
我们的方法将这五个任务纳入一个统一的架构中——一个共享的编码器-解码器,配有几个轻量级任务特定投影仪. 在多任务学习范式下,我们看到了一个互补的性能增益,分别实现了最先进的PQ53.1和CO-val泛光学和语义分离的mIoU66.5。
此外,自上而下的关键点检测通常由于多次前传而产生高额的计算费用,对于这一检测,我们采用了一种基于知识的蒸馏法,使单一前传在整个图像上,大大提高了效率。
归根结底,我们的模式提供了一个轻量级的、但有效的多任务学习框架,显示出在五项愿景任务方面的有力业绩。

blocks.en: Generalist models aim to solve multiple tasks within a single unified framework, eliminating the need for separate task-specific models. Given the inherently multitask nature, technically, building generalist models is closely aligned with multi-task learning, sharing the goal of optimizing a model to handle diverse tasks efficiently.
blocks.zh: 通用模型旨在在一个单一的统一框架内解决多个任务,消除了单独的任务特定模型的需求. 鉴于内在的多任务性质,技术上,建设通俗主义模式与多任务学习紧密结合,共享优化模式以高效处理不同任务的目标.

blocks.en: In the NLP domain, generalist multitask learning has achieved remarkable success, with models such as [ 1 , 16 ] , demonstrating strong performance across diverse language tasks. This success is largely attributed to the shared nature of text representations, where different language tasks can be formulated within a common sequence-to-sequence or auto-regressive framework. However, developing generalist multitask learning in vision remains is significantly more challenging due to the inherent diversity in vision tasks. Vision tasks span a broad range of dense and sparse predictions, each requiring distinct output structures and optimization objectives. For example, semantic segmentation operates at the pixel level, depth estimation requires continuous value regression, while object detection involves structured bounding box predictions. These fundamental differences make it difficult to design a generalist framework that seamlessly accommodates all vision tasks within a single model.
blocks.zh: 在NLP领域,通论多任务学习取得了显著成功,有[1,16]等模式,展现出不同语言任务间的强效表现. 这一成功主要归功于文本表述的共享性质,在文本表述中,不同的语言任务可以在共同的顺序到顺序或自动递归的框架内制定. 然而,由于愿景任务的内在多样性,在愿景方面发展通俗主义的多任务学习仍然具有更大的挑战性。 远景任务涉及广泛的密集和稀疏的预测,每项任务都需要不同的产出结构和优化目标。 例如,语义分解在像素水平上运行,深度估计需要持续值回归,而对象检测则涉及结构化的边框预测. 这些根本的区别使得难以设计一个无缝地将所有愿景任务放在一个单一模式内的总论框架.

blocks.en: To tackle this, some studies focus on task output homogenization, where various task outputs are manually encoded into a shared format through hand-crafted methods. In this context, Painter [ 51 ] approaches many vision tasks as image inpainting problems, encoding task outputs in the RGB space. Pix2Seq-D [ 4 ] also leverages the Bit Diffusion model [ 6 ] to learn task-specific outputs by converting them into per-pixel representations across separate channels. Alternatively, other approaches add components to serialize both the input image and task outputs, treating the problem as a next-token prediction task. For instance, Unified-IO [ 30 ] employs a VQ-GAN [ 13 ] to serialize dense tasks and adds special tokens for sparse tasks. In this paradigm, the generalist model is trained on the frozen tokens, and the outputs need to be further decoded. However, both these approaches come with trade-offs, as they introduce complexity through demanding pre- and post-processing, along with the need for sophisticated training techniques, such as VQ-GAN for serialization.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,一些研究侧重于任务输出同质化,通过手工制作的方法,将各种任务产出手工编码成共享格式。 在此背景下,Painter [51] 将许多视觉任务作为图像涂装问题,编码RGB空间中的任务输出. Pix2Seq-D [4] 也利用Bit Difusion模型 [6] 通过将特定任务输出转换成跨不同渠道的每像素表示来学习特定任务输出. 或者,其他办法增加组件,将输入图像和任务输出都序列化,将问题视为下一个预测任务。 例如,United-IO [30] 使用一个VQ-GAN [13]来序列密集的任务,并为稀疏的任务添加特殊标志. 在这个范式中,通论模型接受过冷冻符式的培训,输出需要进一步解码. 然而,这两种方法都有取舍,因为它们通过要求进行前处理和后处理带来复杂性,同时需要复杂的培训技术,如序列化的VQ-GAN。

blocks.en: In generalist multitasking, it is also essential to unify different vision tasks under a common problem-solving methodology. Among these tasks, person keypoint detection often follows a top-down strategy, where individuals are cropped from the image, and keypoints are then detected for each cropped person. This approach has become the standard due to the effectiveness of person detectors. However, it requires running the model multiple times, once for each individual in the image, which goes against the core idea of generalist multitasking, where the goal is to process the entire image and perform multiple tasks in a single forward pass. This multiple-run process is especially expensive in generalist vision models, which rely on large, computationally intensive encoder backbones. Despite this, no significant effort has been made to address this issue while still leveraging the strengths of the top-down approach.
blocks.zh: 在笼统的多重任务中,还必须在共同的解决问题方法下统一不同的愿景任务。 在这些任务中,人的关键点检测往往遵循自上而下的战略,即个人从图像中裁剪,然后对每个被裁剪的人检测关键点. 由于人造探测器的效能,这种方法已成为标准. 然而,它需要多次运行模型,一次针对图像中的每个个体,这违背了泛论多任务的核心思想,即目标是在一次前传中处理整个图像并完成多个任务. 这种多运行的过程在通论视觉模型中特别昂贵,这些模型依赖于大型,计算密集的编码器骨干. 尽管如此,在利用自上而下办法的优势的同时,没有作出重大努力来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: We propose a simple yet effective training framework, as in Fig. 1 , namely AHMAD, for generalist multitasking across different vision tasks: Panoptic Segmentation (Semantic Segmentation (SS) and Instance Segmentation (IS)), Depth Estimation (DE), Keypoint Detection (KD), and Object Detection (OD), demonstrating a complementary boost for the majority of tasks. Additionally, we introduce a novel method to reduce the forward passes required for top-down keypoint detection, achieving a single run for the entire image using knowledge distillation techniques.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个简单而有效的培训框架,如图1,即AHMAD,用于跨不同愿景任务的泛视分片(语义分片(SS)和实例分片(IS)),深度估计(DE),关键点检测(KD)和物体检测(OD),显示出对大多数任务的互补推动。 此外,我们引入了一种新的方法,以减少自上而下的关键点检测所需的前进通道,利用知识蒸馏技术实现整个图像的单一运行.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1) We present a simple multitask learning paradigm with no restrictions on task output shapes or the need for extra components, allowing the incorporation of each task’s ideal single-task approach within a unified multitask structure. 2) We propose a novel distillation method to perform top-down keypoint detection with just a single forward pass for the entire image. 3) We demonstrate strong performance across various vision tasks, achieving a PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO panoptic and semantic segmentation among generalist models, while also delivering competitive results in keypoint detection and object detection.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: (1) 我们提出了一个简单的多任务学习模式,对任务输出形状或额外组件的需要没有限制,允许将每个任务的理想单一任务方法纳入统一的多任务结构。 2)我们提出一种新颖的蒸馏方法来进行自上而下的关键点检测,整个图像只需一个前传. 3) 我们展现出各种愿景任务的有力表现,在通论模型中,CO泛光学和语义分解的PQ为53.1,mIoU为66.5,同时在关键点检测和物体检测中也取得了竞争性结果。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision Transformers. Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 21 , 37 ] have emerged as powerful foundations for both multi-task and multimodal learning in computer vision [ 45 ] . Swin Transformer [ 28 ] introduces hierarchical feature by partitioning images into non-overlapping windows and computing self-attention within each. This enables efficient modeling of long-range dependencies through a shifting window mechanism. ViTs also excel in self-supervised learning [ 26 , 44 , 58 ] , acting as strong backbones for various vision tasks. Methods like DINO [ 3 ] and DINOv2 [ 34 ] leverage unsupervised pretraining based on knowledge distillation on large unlabeled data, enabling them to learn transferable representations for different downstream tasks. Furthermore, ViTs are effective in multimodal learning [ 18 ] , particularly in vision-language tasks [ 56 ] such as visual question answering [ 43 ] , where combining visual and textual data enhances overall comprehension.
blocks.zh: 视觉变形器. 愿景变换器[21,37]已成为计算机愿景中多任务和多模式学习的强大基础[45]。 Swin Transformer [28] 引入了等级特征,将图像分割成非重叠窗口,并计算每个窗口内部的自我注意. 这使得能够通过一个变化的窗口机制对长期依赖性进行有效的建模。 ViTs在自我监督的学习方面也表现优异[26,44,58],充当各种愿景任务的强大骨干. DINO[3]和DINov2[34]等方法利用基于大型无标签数据上的知识蒸馏的未经监督的预训,使他们能够为不同的下游任务学习可转移的表示. 此外,ViTs在多式联运学习[18]方面是有效的,特别是在视觉语言任务[56]方面,例如视觉问题回答[43],其中将视觉数据和文字数据结合起来可增进总体理解。

blocks.en: Segmentation and Object Detection. Transformer-based models excel in dense tasks like segmentation [ 31 ] . MaskFormer [ 8 ] frames segmentation as hierarchical mask generation and classification, while Mask2Former [ 7 ] refines it with multi-scale masked attention. OneFormer [ 19 ] extends this with task-conditioned training for handling diverse segmentation tasks. SAM [ 22 ] generates high-quality object masks from both sparse and dense prompts, using a MAE-pretrained Vision Transformer [ 17 ] as the encoder and a prompt encoder for boxes, points, and text (encoded using CLIP [ 36 ] ), with support for dense mask prompts encoded by a CNN network. SAM2 [ 38 ] builds on this with a promptable visual segmentation framework, incorporating a memory bank and attention mechanism for improved accuracy. Transformers [ 47 ] are also widely used for open-vocabulary object detection [ 55 , 15 , 33 , 12 , 32 , 9 ] , leveraging autoregressive next-token prediction. Grounding DINO [ 27 ] detects objects from language inputs, with a Swin transformer for image encoding, BERT [ 10 ] for text, and deformable self-attention [ 52 ] for feature enhancement. It also employs language-guided query selection and a cross-modality decoder for bounding box prediction. Grounding DINO 1.5 [ 41 ] enhances this with Pro and Edge versions, offering a larger ViT-L backbone and cross-scale feature fusion for improved performance. Grounded SAM [ 42 ] merges Grounding DINO and SAM for both segmentation and detection, using BLIP [ 25 , 24 ] and RAM [ 57 ] for vision-language understanding.
blocks.zh: 分裂和物体探测。 基于变形器的模型在像分割等密集任务中表现优异[31]. MaskFormer [8] 帧分解作为分级的面具生成和分类,而Mask2Former [7] 则用多尺度的蒙面注意来细化它. OneFormer [19] 扩展了这一范围,为处理各种分化任务提供了符合任务条件的培训。 SAM [22]从稀疏和稠密的提示中生成高质量的对象口罩,使用MAE预装的Vision变形器[17]作为编码器,并使用盒,点和文本的快速编码器(使用CLIP [36]编码),支持由CNN网络编码的稠密口罩提示. SAM2[38]以此为基础,采用了快速的视觉分解框架,纳入了记忆库和注意机制,以提高准确性. 变形器 [47] 也广泛用于开伏物体检测[55, 15, 33, 12, 32, 9] , 利用自旋式的下托式预测. 地面DINO [27] 探测语言输入的物体,带有用于图像编码的Swin变压器,用于文本的BERT [10],用于特性增强的可变形自留心[52]. 它还使用语言指导的查询选择和跨模式解码器进行边框预测。 定位DINO 1.5 [41]用Pro和Edge版本加强了这一功能,为改进性能提供了更大的VIT-L主干和跨尺度的特性聚变. 基础 SAM [42] 合并 使用BLIP[25,24]和RAM[57]进行视觉语言理解,将DINO和SAM进行分解和检测.

blocks.en: Multitask Generalist Models. Expanding beyond models that are strictly designed for segmentation and detection tasks, Painter [ 51 ] frames dense vision tasks as image inpainting, with outputs in the same RGB space as input images. The task prompt is encoded as a pair of images, and a Masked Vision Transformer is used for training. At inference, Painter offers flexible task adaptation through three types of prompts: random, searched, and learned. Unified-IO [ 30 , 29 ] introduced an encoder-decoder architecture, using stacked transformer layers to represent all inputs and outputs as discrete tokens. It utilizes VQ-GAN [ 13 ] for image serialization and incorporates location tokens and sparse structures like bounding boxes as special tokens. However, the model has limitations in localization. Pix2Seq [ 5 ] takes an image and task prompts to generate discrete tokens corresponding to desired outputs, while Pix2Seq-D [ 4 ] handles semantic and instance segmentation with two channels per task. GiT [ 48 ] divides the image into subregions, generating sparse responses for each, which are then merged. DINO-X [ 40 ] extends the Grounding DINO encoder-decoder architecture for open-world understanding, supporting text, visual, and customized prompts. The DINO-X Pro version uses a pre-trained CLIP model to enhance performance across multimodal benchmarks, with visual prompts leveraging box and point formats for better segmentation and visual grounding tasks.
blocks.zh: 多任务通用模型. 扩展到严格为分解和检测任务设计的模型之外,Painter [51] 帧密集的视觉任务作为图像涂装,输出在与输入图像相同的RGB空间中. 任务提示被编码为一对图像,并使用一个蒙面视觉变形器进行训练. 推论,Painter通过随机,搜索,学习三种类型的提示,提供灵活的任务调整. United-IO [30,29] 引入了编码器-解码器架构,使用堆叠式变压器层来代表所有输入和输出作为离散符号. 它利用VQ-GAN [13]来进行图像序列化,并将定位符和像边框这样的稀疏结构作为特殊符. 然而,该模型在本地化方面有局限性. Pix2Seq [5] 采用图像和任务提示来生成对应期望输出的离散符号,而Pix2Seq-D [4] 处理语义和实例分割,每个任务有两个通道. GiT [48] 将图像划分为次区域,每个区域产生很少的响应,然后合并. DINO-X [40] 扩展了Grounding DINO编码器-解码器架构,用于开放世界的理解,支持文本,视觉,以及定制的提示. DINO-X Pro版本使用经过预训的CLIP模型来提升跨多式联运基准的性能,可视化提示可以利用框和点格式来更好的分区和可视化地面任务.

blocks.en:
Backbone. Our backbone is built upon ViT-L [ 11 ] , utilizing weights obtained via the Dino-V2 [ 34 ] strategy, which leverages self-supervised learning. This reliance on large-scale pretrained weights enables the model to learn rich, generalizable feature representations that are not tied to any specific task.
This is particularly well-suited for our design, where task-specific projectors specialize the learned features for different tasks. This enables the model to efficiently share common features while adapting to the unique requirements of each task.
blocks.zh:
后b骨. 利用通过Dino-V2[34]战略获得的权重, 这种对大规模预先训练的权重的依赖,使模型能够学习与任何具体任务无关的丰富而笼统的特征表述.
这特别适合我们的设计,具体任务投影仪专门掌握不同任务的学习特点。 这使得模型能够有效地分享共同的特点,同时适应每项任务的独特要求。

blocks.en: Decoder. The decoder comprises four transposed convolutional layers whose goal is to upscale the patch level representations to pixel level representations. Although the decoder is significantly lighter than the backbone, it is considerably larger than the task-specific projectors. This is because the task projectors are not intended to focus on deeply extracting new features, but to simply project this representation to the required output format for the task.

blocks.en: KD Projector. We solve the 17-joint keypoint detection problem ( j = 5 ) (j=5) using a top-down approach, where cropped instances of individuals are processed independently. Instead of predicting separate heatmaps for each joint, we generate a single unified heatmap capturing all joints simultaneously, along with 17 classification channels trained exclusively on ground truth keypoints. We found this formulation significantly more efficient than the conventional approach of predicting one heatmap per joint. With all but one channel representing discrete class labels, this encoding is particularly well-suited for knowledge distillation, enabling the proposal of KD * ( 3.2 ). blocks.en: 3.2 KD * :Single-pass Top-down Keypoint Detection
blocks.zh: 3.2 KD *: 单程通过自上而下键位检测

blocks.en: In top-down keypoint detection, the entire network must run repeatedly for each instance in an image, leading to increased inference time and resource consumption—an issue exacerbated by the use of a large backbone. This contradicts the essence of efficient multitasking. To overcome this, we leverage knowledge distillation to enable the keypoint detection with just one forward pass for the entire image.
blocks.zh: 在自上而下的关键点检测中,整个网络必须在一个图像中反复运行,从而增加推断时间和资源消耗,而使用大型骨干则加剧了这一问题。 这与高效的多重任务的本质相矛盾. 为了克服这一点,我们利用知识的蒸馏, 使关键点检测能够 仅通过一个前传 整个图像。

blocks.en: In our streamlined implementation of the keypoint detection task, we found that strong optimization performance could be achieved by directly using a part of the latent image representation z 4 = B θ 4 ​ ( x ) {}_{4}z={}_{4}B_{\theta}(x) , bypassing the decoder (indicated by the blue arrows in Figure 3 ). This approach generates a feature map suitable for cropped RGB images of individuals, but in a much more efficient manner, without being part of the multitasking pipeline. Building on this observation, we propose a knowledge distillation paradigm that aligns the feature map of cropped images with the corresponding regions of the full-image feature map. This technique allows us to reduce the forward passes from one per individual to a single pass for the entire image, essentially cropping the feature map instead of the RGB input.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup and Implementation

blocks.en: Three-Stage Training. We adopt a three-stage training strategy. In the first stage, we train only on the IS task, the most challenging one, for a substantial number of epochs using low-resolution images (280 × \times 280). In the second stage, we extend training to all tasks while maintaining the same low resolution and training for many epochs. Finally, in the third stage, we fine-tune the pretrained weights on high-resolution images (616 × \times 616) with significantly reduced augmentation and for considerably fewer epochs. The idea here is that most of the training occurs on computationally efficient low-resolution data, while fine-tuning on high-resolution images refines the model effectively without incurring excessive computational cost.
blocks.zh: 三阶训导. 我们采取三阶段培训战略。 在第一阶段,我们只对使用低分辨率图像的大量时代(280x\times 280)进行IS任务的培训,这是最具挑战性的任务。 在第二阶段,我们向所有任务提供培训,同时保持同样的低分辨率,并对许多时代进行培训。 最后,在第三阶段,我们对高分辨率图像(616×\times 616)上预先训练的重量进行微调,并显著减少增量,缩短历程。 这里的想法是,大多数培训都涉及计算效率低的分辨率数据,而高分辨率图像的微调则可以有效地完善模型,而不会产生过高的计算成本.

blocks.en: The three training stages run for 280, 150, and 60 epochs, respectively, totaling 5 days. Each stage uses a 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} learning rate, 0.6 decay, a 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} minimum learning rate, and 0.6 layer decay for the backbone. A warmup period of 10 epochs is applied. The effective batch sizes are 1024, 512, and 256 for the three stages, respectively. We use 4 intermediate layers of the backbone, specifically layers 4, 11, 17, and 23. We set L = 4 L=4 in IS task, as ablated in Table 3 . In the object detection task, we use ( B , S ) (B,S) of ( 2 , 7 ) (2,7) and ( 2 , 10 ) (2,10) in the second and third stages, respectively. For KD task, the heatmap size, h ​ s hs , is set to 4 / 7 4/7 ( σ = 10 \sigma=10 ) of the image resolution in the second and third stages. For tasks involving EDS, we include an additional total variation loss as a regularizer. Specifically for the IS task, we also incorporate generalized DICE loss (SupMat 1.2).

blocks.en: We evaluate the performance of our multi-task learning pipeline using task-specific metrics on the COCO-val split. Specifically, for panoptic segmentation, we report Panoptic Quality (PQ), and for semantic segmentation, we use mean Intersection over Union (mIoU). For depth estimation, we report Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), for object detection, we use mean Average Precision (mAP), and for keypoint detection, we provide OKS-based mAP. Table 1 compares these results with those from other specialized and multi-task generalist vision models, highlighting key performance trends.
blocks.zh: 我们利用关于COCO-val分裂的具体任务衡量标准,评估我们多任务学习管道的业绩。 具体来说,对于泛光分解,我们报告泛光分解的质量(PQ),对于语义分解,我们使用中间分解(intersection over Union(mIoU)). 对于深度估计,我们报告根平均平方误差(RMSE),对于对象检测,我们使用平均精度(mAP),对于关键点检测,我们提供基于OKS的mAP. 表1将这些结果与其他专门和多任务通用构想模型的结果作了比较,突出了关键的业绩趋势。

blocks.en: Notably, our approach achieves strong performance in panoptic segmentation, surpassing other models with a PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5. This represents a 22.3% boost compared to Painter and a 5.5% boost compared to Pix2Seq-D. As for semantic segmentation, we outperform LDM by a Δ ​ mIoU \Delta\text{mIoU} of 6.4 and significantly surpass GiT with a Δ ​ mIoU \Delta\text{mIoU} of 14.1. For depth estimation, we only compare the results of AHMAD single to AHMAD multi (since other models use different ground truth labels for training, as noted by * in Table 1 ), highlighting the complementary boost gained from joint training. We also achieve competitive results with an OKS-mAP of 68.12 for keypoint detection and an mAP of 44.6 for object detection, demonstrating the effectiveness of our multi-task framework in improving performance through joint training.

blocks.en: As for our proposed KD * method, we demonstrate how distilling information from the teacher feature map to the student feature map allows us to reduce the number of forward passes by a factor of 2.7x. This makes the entire multi-task paradigm unified, where the model processes the same input image for different tasks and generates the results in a single forward pass. Table 2 presents the statistics. The results from Table 4 further demonstrate that, with sufficient engineering effort, performance progressively improves, validating the efficacy of the approach. Additionally, there is potential for further enhancement as more engineering is applied.

Beyond the performance gains achieved through knowledge distillation, it is noteworthy that the bypassed path alone achieves strong metric scores. This highlights the suitability and effectiveness of the DINO-V2 backbone within our hybrid training framework. To better approximate real-world inference in top-down keypoint detection, we introduce 20% noise into the ground-truth bounding boxes when cropping input images.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce AHMAD, a generalist multitasking framework that integrates five key vision tasks—semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection—within a unified model. Our approach efficiently handles heterogeneous task outputs without complex serialization or pre/post-processing. To further improve efficiency, we propose a knowledge distillation strategy for keypoint detection, enabling a single forward pass instead of multiple passes required by traditional top-down methods. Experiments demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, with state-of-the-art results in panoptic and semantic segmentation. AHMAD offers a simple yet effective multitask framework, balancing efficiency and flexibility for real-world applications. Future work includes refining distillation techniques, incorporating higher-resolution training, and expanding to additional vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了AHMAD,这是一个概括性的多任务框架,将五个关键远景任务——语义分化、实例分化、深度估计、关键点检测和物体检测——纳入一个统一的模型。 我们的方法有效地处理各种任务产出,而无需复杂的序列化或前/后处理。 为了进一步提高效率,我们提出了关键点检测的知识分解战略,使一个单一的前进通道而不是传统自上而下的方法所要求的多个通道。 实验显示在所有任务中都有很强的性能,最先进的结果是泛光学和语义分解. AHMAD提供了一个简单而有效的多任务框架,平衡了效率和现实世界应用的灵活性。 今后的工作包括精炼蒸馏技术,纳入更高分辨率的培训,以及扩大到额外的视觉任务.
